name: ThyncSpace
title: ThyncSpace: document notes, whiteboards and calculations
description: A technical workspace for document notes, editable diagrams, calculations and permission-based collaboration.

sections.heading: What is ThyncSpace for?
paragraphs: Combine writing, whiteboards and calculations in a technical workspace. Documentation notes can contain text and diagram sections with an outline and reading view.

sections.heading: Can people work together?
paragraphs: Sharing and real-time collaboration use the configured backend and the note permissions. The frontend alone is not a hosted collaboration service.

sections.heading: Can I export my work?
paragraphs: Documentation notes support Word and PDF snapshot exports. Diagrams become images in these exports; exports are not a replacement for the editable source workspace.

sections.heading: Does it work offline?
paragraphs: The installable web app can retain explicitly selected offline copies. Offline copies do not grant server access or imply that unsynced changes have reached the server.

sections.heading: Is there a native store app?
paragraphs: This repository provides a web application and PWA. A native Google Play or Apple App Store release is not established by this source checkout.
